1300|3142c9a2.name: Lawrence Schneider
1300|3142c9a2.text: Very well, let your journey of tailoring begin.

1300|d1216699.name: Lawrence Schneider
1300|d1216699.text: Life is like a carefully woven tapestry.

1300|e17121fb.name: Lawrence Schneider
1300|e17121fb.text: Hmm... the things you need to learn are a little above my head. Have a talk with Sellandus over at Larson's Clothiers just up the path to the right. He taught me everything I know!

1309|0624ab70.name: Wynne Larson
1309|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1314|23d8b931.name: Duncan Cullen
1314|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1346|29243a62.name: Georgio Bolero
1346|29243a62.text: You'll need more training before I can share my knowledge with you, I'm afraid.

1347|0624ab70.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1347|23d8b931.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1976|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

1976|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

1976|d2d09c41.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|d2d09c41.text: Duncan's Textiles employs one of the finest tailors in Stormwind, Georgio Bolero. Look for the shop over in the Mage Quarter.

197|877c25a9.name: Marshal McBride
197|877c25a9.text: Hey, citizen!  You look like a stout one.  We guards are spread a little thin out here, and I could use your help...

247226|58a0ba23.name: Kelsey Fargo
247226|58a0ba23.text: Blast these kobolds. I can't get any work done with them running back and forth, getting in my way. Well, I've got nothing better to do. Would you like to learn about mining techniques? Or perhaps you just need some new tools?

247229|55b52cc4.name: Daniel
247229|55b52cc4.text: What does Brother Paxton need now?

247229|58cf691f.name: Daniel
247229|58cf691f.text:
I am glad you asked!

Professions are skills pertaining to crafting, gathering, and general survival. There are many to choose from, with each offering their own unique benefits and economic opportunities. Whether you seek wealth, an opportunity to stock your guild's warehouse with useful items, or simply enjoy the satisfaction of wearing equipment crafted by your own hand, there's a profession for that.

Crafting recipes can be learned from trainers, such as those around here, and numerous other sources across Azeroth. Once learned, you can craft as many of that item as you wish, provided you can acquire the necessary materials.

247229|83e0509a.name: Daniel
247229|83e0509a.text:
Hello, $N! Have you considered taking up a tradeskill?

I would be happy to answer any questions you might have, or point you toward the local trainers.

If this feels overwhelming, that's okay! You can always return here or visit trainers in capital cities to get started on your crafting journey at any time.

247229|b3334d4d.name: Daniel
247229|b3334d4d.text:
Of course! Which profession would you like me to guide you towards?

I will mark your map with the location of a local trainer of your choice. Remember that you can visit trainers in capital cities for more thorough training.

247229|e9b56518.name: Daniel
247229|e9b56518.text: Great choice. I have marked that location on your map.

248415|bdfaa98c.name: Tordrin Sternblade
248415|bdfaa98c.text: I heard ol' Marshal McBride was sendin' ye' my way.

258568|ed056522.name: Antonio Bolero
258568|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

5491|08830bac.name: Arthur the Faithful
5491|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

5491|837f02f9.name: Arthur the Faithful
5491|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

5503|01ed62ab.name: Eldraeith
5503|01ed62ab.text: Made by the finest craftsmen in all of Teldrassil, carried by hand from Kalimdor to Azeroth as a sign of the growing alliance between the people of the Great Tree and the humans of this land. If there is anything you require, you have but to ask.

5567|3a20317a.name: Sellandus
5567|3a20317a.text: A fine display of worthiness. Your instruction may now continue.

925|837f02f9.name: Brother Sammuel
925|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

3101-progress.name: Brother Sammuel
3101-progress.text: Finally! We meet face to face, brother to sister. I welcome you to Northshire. This will be your home for a short time while you learn the ins and outs of how things are done, but know that Stormwind is not far off, and sooner or later, your path will take you there. But until then, be patient... Knight of the Silver Hand.
3101-progress.title: Consecrated Letter
